§10.3.2 The Key-Value List

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

forms-the-key-value-list · forms

✅ Normative

Fillable form content MUST be rendered as a Markdown key-value list, not as a table. Every field MUST be one list item using the - marker.

The shape

### \[Part I\] Information About the Partnership

- \[A\] **Partnership's employer identification number**: 27-4162308
- \[D\] **Check if this is a publicly traded partnership (PTP)**: [ ]
- **CONTACT NAME:** Melinda Clayton
- **FAX (A/C, No):** [blank]
- \[G\]
  - [x] General partner or LLC member-manager
  - [ ] Limited partner or other LLC member
- **Your signature**: [signature: John Doe]

The line format

- \[id\] **Label**: value
  • The id and the label MUST each appear only when printed. A field with no printed id carries no brackets.
  • An id MUST be written in escaped square brackets — \[1a\] — outside the bold label.
  • An empty fill-in MUST be rendered as [blank]. A checkbox MUST be rendered as [x] (checked) or [ ] (unchecked).
  • An option line MUST be box-first: - [x] Single.
  • A printed section heading MUST be rendered as a Markdown heading. A box whose id covers several fields MUST be rendered as a parent list item with the fields nested beneath it.

Why the id is escaped

\[x\] is a printed field designator "x"; [x] is a checked box. Without the escape the two cannot be told apart, and a field id silently becomes a tick.

Colons

  • When the printed label ends in :, the colon MUST stay inside the bold label: - **CONTACT NAME:** Melinda Clayton.
  • When the value is not printed on the same line as its label — a caption printed under its line, an answer area below its question — the : after the label MUST be omitted: - **SIGNATURE OF DEPONENT** [blank].
